annotations.title: Head-to-head of two stocks or ETFs

description: Five-year head-to-head of two covered stocks or ETFs from weekly closes adjusted for dividends and splits: total and annualized return, 1-, 3- and 5-year returns, volatility, worst drawdown and worst week, correlation, what $10,000 became, plus each one's dividend yield, beta and (for funds) fee. Use it for "SCHD vs VIG", "NVDA vs AMD".
name: compare
title: Head-to-head of two stocks or ETFs
